06:00 - 10:00 4.00 WAITING FOR VETCO GREY COMPANY TO RECOVER WEAR BUSHING. IN THE MEANTIME: PROPESA COMPANY PERSONNEL AND TEST UNIT, TESTED CHOKE ASSEMBLY (VALVE X VALVE) WITH 300 PSI LOW AND 8000 PSI. HIGH WELL. IPC COMPANY PERSONNEL TESTED MUD PUMPS WITH NEW 5-1/2"X11" HYDRAULICS AND CHECKED ELECTRIC MOTOR N. 1 OF MAIN DRAWWORKS.
10:00 - 11:00 1.00 WITH VETCO GRAY COMPANY PERSONNEL RECOVERED WEAR BUSHING.
11:00 - 00:00 13.00 WITH PROPESA COMPANY UNIT INSTALLED CUP TESTER, ATTEMPTED TO TEST BOPS 13-5/8"-10M W/E ON REPEATED OCCASIONS. W/O SUCCESS CHANGED CUP ATTEMPTED TO TEST AGAIN W/E. PULLED TESTER TO SURFACE AND CHANGED FOR VETCO COMPANY TEST PLUG AND TESTED SPHERICAL PREVENTER 13-5/8"-10M WITH 300PSI LOW AND 7000PSI HIGH 40 MIN WELL. HR. DUE TO FAILURE IN TEST UNIT. REPAIRED FAILURE IN HYDRAULIC FLUID HOSE. ATTEMPTED TO TEST UPPER RAM PREVENTER AND BLIND RAM OBSERVING LEAK IN TEST PLUG 'O' RING. CONNECTED CUP TESTER WITH EXTENSION AND ATTEMPTED TO TEST AGAIN W/E, OBSERVED THAT PROPESA COMPANY TEST CUP DOES NOT PACK. REQUESTED ANOTHER TEST CUP FROM PROPESA COMPANY, INSTALLED NEW CUP AND ATTEMPTED TO TEST AGAIN W/E, CUP DID NOT PACK. WAITED FOR VETCO COMPANY TEST PLUG AND INSTALLED. CURRENT PROGRESS TEST OF BOPS 13-5/8"-10M WITH 300PSI LOW AND 8000PSI HIGH: 25%
